name: GoetheLab 5axisFDM 0.4 nozzle
printer_notes: GoetheLab (FH Aachen) 5axisFDM: Prusa i3 MK3S head over a tilt-rotary table, RepRapFirmware, axes X Y Z U V. Kinematics from the lab's 5axisFDM viewer (gcode_viewer.html PP block and machine_mesh.py): U tilts the table about Y and V turns it about Z; the work origin is the centre of the 70 mm round plate on its surface, where both axes cross (part z offset 0). The Y stage carries the table, so joint Y runs opposite to the part; U is written with the opposite sign of the right-hand tilt about Y. Limits from the viewer: U -70..120 deg, X -110..110 mm, Y -70..40 mm; V turns continuously. Maximum speeds X/Y/Z/U/V 20000/20000/2400/20000/20000 mm/min or deg/min (config.g M203). RepRapFirmware applies F to the combined XYZUV length with degrees counted as mm, so F is chosen per move to keep the planned tip speed on the part. Printable height 100 mm above the plate: the lab's end G-code already lifts the head to Z95, and parts may overhang the 70 mm plate as long as their footprint sits on it (head, table and cradle clearance is checked per move). Head and table envelope from the lab's extruder.stl, rotary_table.stl and cradle.stl, 0.3 mm margins. Start and end follow the lab's propeller.gcode: G28 is left to the operator, the filament wiper macro primes the nozzle, the head lifts along the tool axis before the table flattens.
machine_start_gcode:
; part z offset: 0
M104 S[first_layer_temperature] ; preheat nozzle
M140 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; rotary table is not heated
G90
M83
;G28 ; the operator homes before the job
M109 S[first_layer_temperature] ; wait for nozzle temperature
M98 P/macros/filamentWiper ; clean and prime the nozzle
M400
M83
G0 Z45 F2400 ; rise straight up before any XY move
G0 X0 Y0 Z45 U0 V0 F4800 ; table flat, nozzle over the plate centre
machine_end_gcode:
G91
G1 Z10 F2400 ; lift along the tool axis before the table flattens
G90
G1 Z95 F2400
G1 X0 Y0 U0 F4800 ; flatten the table
M104 S0
M140 S0
M107
